_doc: Per-device expectations for the device matrix (app/tests/test_device_matrix.gd, harness app/tests/devicematrix/matrix.gd).
invariants: rules for every device. limits: slider ranges (ids are globs; numbers or devices.json row paths, a list = the largest present).
dbus: values left in the fake steamos-manager/PowerStation props; hhd_tdp: hhd's TDP; root_set: numeric args of 'gamecove-fix-set <verb> set <n>'.
facts: what tested community projects know per handheld (cited). Checked whenever a matching control is registered and available:
tdp: power.tdp* (not *boost*/*sppt*/*fppt*) min >= min, max <= max; *sppt*/*boost* max <= sppt_max (else max); *fppt* <= fppt_max (else sppt_max, max).
rgb.present false: controller.rgb*/controller.led* must be unavailable. rgb.sysfs_leds: the LED class names gen.py creates (none = HID/EC only).

devices: exact checks your provider promises, keyed by device id or selector (*, generic, vendor:amd|intel, driver:amdgpu|xe|i915, stack:hhd|inputplumber|steamos-manager|powerstation, or a devices.json trait selector such as soc:lunar-lake|panther-lake, controller:msi-claw, panel:<id>; 'a+b' = both). Prefer a trait selector when the behaviour comes from a shared part, so siblings are checked too (python3 tools/traits/traits.py trait <selector> lists them).
keys: available, reason_contains, kind, unit, min, max, min_ge, max_le, step, options_include, options_exclude, value, note; 'ac': {...} overrides for the charger-plugged scenario.
A listed control id that no provider registers fails the test, so add entries in the same change as the provider.
_resolved: how the devices.json / hhd / HueSync conflicts were settled (each row's 'notes' cites its source).

msi-claw-8-ex._source: MSI Claw 8 EX on Bazzite 45 as read live 2026-11-09 (Claw 8 EX AI+, MS-1T91, BIOS E1T91IMS.10E, kernel 7.2.15-ogc1.1): InputPlumber + PowerStation + steamos-manager, no Handheld Daemon (tools/devicematrix/overrides.json). TDP 8-35 W: hhd CLAW_EX_DATA and ClawDeck; firmware ignores SPPT/FPPT (ClawDeck tests/test_hardware_findings.py §12); RGB through hid-msi's go:rgb:joystick_rings.

lenovo-legion-go-s-z2go._source: Lenovo Legion Go S (83L3, Z2 Go, 8" IPS 120 Hz VRR). Fixture stack: steamos-manager + PowerStation + InputPlumber. TDP 5-30 W on battery, 33 W plugged (devices.json; hhd allows 40 W on AC, kept at 33). Boost: hhd lenovo/__init__.py L49-55 (gos) SPPT = SPL + 3, FPPT = min(53, SPL*53/40), capped at devices.json sppt_max 33 / fppt_max 41. RGB on Linux needs hhd or the hid-lenovo-go LED driver (HueSync LegionGoSLEDDevice); the fixture has neither.

power.fppt.note: fixture SPL 30 W: up to floor(30*1.325) = 39

power.charge_limit.note: devices.json charge_limit false; Lenovo uses battery care

controller.led_effect.note: no LED node and no hhd in this fixture

perf.upscaler.note: Z2 Go is RDNA2: no FSR 4 (games.py)

asus-rog-ally._source: ASUS ROG Ally (RC71L, Z1 Extreme, 7" IPS 120 Hz VRR). Fixture stack: steamos-manager + PowerStation + InputPlumber. TDP 5-25 W on battery, 30 W plugged (hhd ALLY_DATA max_tdp_dc 25, max_tdp 30). Boost: hhd asus/__init__.py L51-53, L370-380 SPPT <= min(35, SPL*1.2), FPPT <= min(35, SPL*1.4). Fan: asus_custom_fan_curve, 8 points, never under hhd's minimum curve. RGB: HueSync asus_ally.py (ally:rgb:joystick_rings).

perf.upscaler.note: Z1 Extreme is RDNA3: FSR 4 opt-in

power.smt.note: no SMT on Lunar Lake / Panther Lake

_resolved: 2026-11-08: every devices.json / hhd / HueSync conflict reconciled in devices.json; each changed row has a 'notes' line with its source.

Lowered to hhd's safe values: asus-rog-xbox-ally-x and -x20 boost_max 45 -> 35 (x20 also min 5 -> 7); onexplayer-3 boost_max 52 -> 42; gpd-win-4 / -mini / -max-2 boost_max 33 -> 32; onexplayer-x1-intel and onexplayer-g1-intel plugged_max 35 -> 30 and boost_max 40 -> 32; onexplayer-g1-amd plugged_max 35 -> 30; aokzoe-a1, ayaneo-2, onexplayer-2 plugged_max 33 -> 30 (the makers advertise 33 W on AC; the conservative value stays the default ceiling).
SPPT / FPPT ceilings with hhd's formulas added for the ROG Ally family, Legion Go / Go 2 / Go S and the MSI Claws (tdp.sppt_max, fppt_max, *_ratio, *_over; docs/DEVICES.md).
RGB: aokzoe-a1 / -a1-pro have none (HueSync and hhd agree: rgb null); aokzoe-a1x, onexplayer-g1-amd / -intel and gpd-win-4 have it (rgb via hhd).

Kept on purpose, devices.json being the safer side: lenovo-legion-go-s-* plugged_max 33 (hhd 40 W on AC), steam-deck-* 15 W (SimpleDeckyTDP 20 W), msi-claw-a8 min 8 (hhd 7), Legion Go 2 FPPT 41 (hhd 45), Claw A8 FPPT 40 (hhd 48).
